title: Toronto police officer charged with manslaughter in 2021 death of man in Brampton

article: The SIU is charging an off-duty Toronto police officer with manslaughter in the death of Chadd Facey, 19.
He died in April 2021 after and interaction with two off-duty officers in Brampton.
The SIU says Facey met up with the pair to sell them something, but after the officers realized the item was counterfeit, they chased him.
It's not clear what happened when they caught him.
A friend later took Facey to hospital, where he died.
As a result of the SIU investigation, Constable Calvin Au is charged with one count of manslaughter and one count of aggravated assault.
